sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed page 185 clearly states that current M:F proportions are obtained from summed Dur and Moll reactions in a ten-profile series, and adds the special rule that null and ambivalent reactions are counted only at the Ego factors.

Printed page 186 gives the reaction mapping associated with Figure 18. Dur: h−, s+, e−, hy+, k± or k+, p0, d+, m−. Moll: h+, s−, e+, hy−, k0, p± or p+, d−, m+. The canonical derivative damages several glyphs, so the admitted PDF governs the exact mapping.

Fall 5 applies the scheme to a ten-profile series and supplies a worked numerical example, 10 Dur versus 41 Moll reactions, expressed as M:F = Dur:Moll = 10:41 = 1:4.1. The personal interpretation of that case is not promoted here.

sourceExcerpt: • Die psychosexuellen Triebproportionen M.\F weeden demnach auf Grund der zusammengezählten Dur- und Mollreaktionen in einer Zehnerserie festgestellt. F der Dnrreaktionen : F der MoZ/reaktionen gibt die aktuellen psychosexuellen Triebproportionen der Versuchsperson an.
romanianRendering: În metoda lui Szondi, proporția Dur:Moll se calculează într-o serie de zece profiluri prin însumarea reacțiilor clasificate pe scala Dur și pe scala Moll. Figura 18 furnizează maparea reacțiilor, iar sursa prevede separat cum sunt tratate reacțiile 0 și ± la factorii Eului.
doctrinalStatement: Calculul Dur/Moll este o regulă formală de serie: se clasifică reacțiile factoriale conform scalei din Figura 18, se însumează separat Dur și Moll într-o Zehnerserie și se exprimă raportul ΣDur:ΣMoll (numit istoric M:F de sursă). Maparea exactă este: Dur = h−, s+, e−, hy+, k±/k+, p0, d+, m−; Moll = h+, s−, e+, hy−, k0, p±/p+, d−, m+. Acest calcul produce numai constructul Dur/Moll al modelului și nu stabilește sexul sau identitatea persoanei.
conditions: Use a ten-profile series (`Zehnerserie`) for the source-defined total Dur/Moll proportion.
Use only the exact Figure-18 reaction mapping visually verified from the admitted PDF.
Preserve the source's special handling of null and ambivalent reactions at the Ego factors rather than inventing a generic rule for all factors.
exceptions: Do not infer registered sex, biological sex, gender identity or sexual orientation from the resulting Dur:Moll ratio.
Do not generalize the worked Fall-5 ratio or its personal interpretation to other protocols.
Do not silently normalize OCR-damaged factor signs; the PDF mapping is authoritative.

The worked case is retained only as verification of the method, not as an independent doctrine about homosexuality or personality.
